description: The INITIALIZE WITH FILLER phrase - a 2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): COBOL-85's INITIALIZE is INITIALIZE {identifier-1}... with at most a REPLACING phrase (§1985:VI.6.17.2), 'The INITIALIZE statement provides the ability to set selected types of data fields to predetermined values' (§1985:VI.6.17.1), and its only phrase is REPLACING, 'The key word following the word REPLACING corresponds to a category of data' (§1985:VI.6.17.4 GR1); 2002 adds the phrase, 'INITIALIZE { identifier-1 } … [ WITH FILLER ]' (§2002:14.8.19.1), whose absence excludes 'If the FILLER phrase is not specified, elementary data items with an explicit or implicit FILLER clause.' (§2002:14.8.19.3 GR5), and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 72: 'INITIALIZE statement, FILLER phrase. FILLER data items may be initialized with the INITIALIZE statement.' 2014 and 2023 keep both (§2014:14.9.19.1, §2014:14.9.19.3 GR5; §2023:14.9.20.2, §2023:14.9.20.4 GR5). Folded from the inline InitializeBinder gate (Exec Step E).
